verdict.rationale: Pulumi documents a Cloud REST API, a `pulumi api` CLI command, and an Automation API. However, no evidence item describes API versioning or a published deprecation policy, and the OpenAPI probe returned 404 on all candidate paths. The axis applies to an infrastructure platform with public APIs and SDKs, so absent evidence yields none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
